info.title: Watchmask asynchronous channels
info.description: Verified inbound message channels and Celery queue ownership for a Watchmask instance. Scope is deliberately narrow: polling importers, Apprise notification destinations, and shared base classes are not channels and are excluded.

jellyfinWebhook.title: jellyfinWebhook
jellyfinWebhook.summary: Jellyfin playback, user-rating, and watched-toggle webhook.

jellyseerrWebhook.title: jellyseerrWebhook
jellyseerrWebhook.summary: Jellyseerr request webhook scoped to one user token.

seerrGlobalWebhook.title: seerrGlobalWebhook
seerrGlobalWebhook.summary: Overseerr or Jellyseerr global webhook. Watchmask resolves the owning user from the payload instead of a token in the path.

bingebanditWebhook.title: bingebanditWebhook
bingebanditWebhook.summary: BingeBandit JSON webhook: playback.start and playback.finished track progress, player.* events drive Now Playing, and playback.stop saves a resume point.

cinemaskWebhook.title: cinemaskWebhook
cinemaskWebhook.summary: Cinemask request.created and request.available events, which refresh request status and add requests as Planning.

stremioAddonSubtitles.title: stremioAddonSubtitles
stremioAddonSubtitles.summary: Stremio subtitles request used as a playback-start signal. Stremio re-requests on seek and quality change, so Watchmask throttles to one scrobble per item per window.

stremioAddonPlayer.title: stremioAddonPlayer
stremioAddonPlayer.summary: Stremio player event carrying a playback position and duration in the extra. Sent on play, pause, and stop, and the one source of a resume position for a client that cannot emit a stop.

stremioAddonLibrary.title: stremioAddonLibrary
stremioAddonLibrary.summary: Stremio library change (add, remove, watched, unwatched) for one item, carrying the affected episode ids in `videoId` so a batch arrives as one request.

listenBrainzSubmitListens.title: listenBrainzSubmitListens
listenBrainzSubmitListens.summary: ListenBrainz-compatible listen submission. Handled synchronously by the REST API, not by the webhook task, and described in OpenAPI as well because it has an exact HTTP wire shape.

celery.summary: Background work. Default queue for tasks with no explicit override, including webhook processing and metadata backfills.

interactive.summary: Latency-sensitive work a user is waiting on. Kept isolated so bulk backfills cannot starve it.

x-floppy-worker-plan.description: Queues the background worker consumes at each resource tier. A tier that omits a queue from this list starts a dedicated worker for it instead; no queue is ever dropped.
